Choose an aspect ratio or custom dimensions, then adjust extent, hillshade, pie proportions and decimal precision. Coordinates use ties-to-even rounding, the same rule as R round(). This groups coordinate cells; it is not a radius search.
PNG is a complete raster image. SVG preserves vector markers, boundaries and text with raster terrain. PDF embeds a high-resolution image. Batch maps retain the same extent and full legend.
Administrative boundaries: open data from Taiwan’s Ministry of the Interior, NLSC, converted by
to TopoJSON and decoded as GeoJSON. Includes 22 counties/cities and 368 townships/districts. This is a simplified historical snapshot, not a live boundary update.

(Terrarium), decoded from RGB into meters. Colors follow MAP_TW.R; the Taiwan land boundary masks the sea. Hillshade is computed in the browser. SRTM and GMTED2010 courtesy of USGS; ETOPO1: DOC/NOAA/NESDIS/NCEI.

Maps use Web Mercator (EPSG:3857); scale bars use the center latitude. Browser and R rendering differ, so fonts, shading and symbols are not pixel-identical. Larger exports add image pixels, not source DEM resolution.
Global z1 and Taiwan z8 tiles are bundled. Higher detail or other extents load from AWS. Sources are included in image metadata and batch-download source notes.
